prompt: Original 60-second instrumental composition. Instruments exclusively: close felt piano and soft acoustic bass. 78 BPM. delicate two-note questions and quiet warm answers. A distinctive concise motif, moderate variation every eight bars, no long introduction, clean resolved ending. Designed as a restrained background for a narrated video. No human voices, speech, singing, humming, choir or vocal samples. Clear natural instrument timbres with no feedback or clipping.
